ruling.explanation:
To the driver and to the rider: this is a driver-filed dispute, so the question is whether the $6 no-show fee should be restored to the driver. It should not, and the payment stays as it is — the rider keeps the $6 refund already credited on 31 July.

The reason is not that either of you invented your position. The trace shows the driver's car within 30 m of the pin, with 25 qualifying in-geofence fixes, and the rider's phone stationary 50–92 m from the same pin from 7.43 am; both of you were genuinely at the Tampines interchange PHV bay. But the fee does not turn on presence, it turns on how long the driver held position measured the way POL-NS-01(c) requires: from the first qualifying fix inside the pickup geofence, not from the moment 'arrived' was tapped. That first qualifying fix is at 07:44:14 and the driver cancelled at 07:48:10 — 236 seconds, which is 64 seconds short of the 300 seconds a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup requires. The trip record's 10.1-minute wait figure is measured from the 'arrived' marker and cannot be used for this test.

The shortfall cannot be closed by adding intervals. POL-NS-06(i) summing is unavailable twice over: the trace shows a single continuous stop (run_count 1), so there is no second interval to add, and the limb requires a present, populated traffic_advisory that the record simply does not contain. So the fee was not chargeable, and the refund already made to the rider was correct. For the same reason the driver is owed no compensation: POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full, and it is not, and POL-NS-06 itself withholds compensation on a shortfall.

Record notes for transparency. The chat log EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 on issue UNREAD_MESSAGE (all three messages carry read_at null); it plays no part in this outcome, which rests on the GPS trace and trip record at full weight, so the discount does not move the ruling. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 on issue MISSING_ARTIFACT and is relied on only for its absence, which cannot itself carry any fact. No escalation applies: the two records do not contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence once the corrected dwell clock is applied, the anti-farming counters (3 no-show terminations in 30 days, 3.4%) are below both POL-NS-07 limbs, and confidence is well above the 0.70 floor. Because the driver filed and the platform has already reversed the fee, POL-GEN-03 makes the correct disposition NO_ACTION — the fee is not restored, and the rider's refund stands.
